inputs.name: useGlobalConfig
inputs.label: Store credentials in temporary global configuration
inputs.helpMarkDown: Opt in to a temporary global npm config instead of modifying workingFile. workingFile remains required for registry discovery and is not modified. Existing global settings are copied; project and user settings, including expired credentials, take precedence. Sets NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG for subsequent steps in this job. The temporary file is removed post-job.

inputs.name: workloadIdentityServiceConnection
inputs.label: 'Azure DevOps' Service Connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Credentials to use for registries located a project's .npmrc file. Use with feedUrl to specify credentials used for the single registry in a .npmrc file. Not compatible with customEndpoint.

inputs.name: feedUrl
inputs.label: Azure Artifacts URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: If this is set, azureDevOpsServiceConnection is required. Not compatible with customEndpoint. Feed Url should be in the npm registry format, e.g. https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/{ORG_NAME}/{PROJECT}/_packaging/{FEED_NAME}/npm/registry/

inputs.name: workingFile
inputs.label: .npmrc file to authenticate
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the .npmrc file that specifies the registries you want to work with. Select the file, not the folder e.g. "/packages/mypackage.npmrc". With useGlobalConfig enabled, this file is read only for registry discovery and is not modified; npm must still load the appropriate project config for package routing. When Azure Artifacts URL and its service connection are set, authentication is restricted to matching registries in this file. Otherwise, post-job cleanup restores the original contents only after validating the backup and confirming this is still the same regular file. If validation fails, cleanup warns and skips restoration without writing file contents. Index-loading, filesystem, and write errors still fail cleanup.

inputs.name: customEndpoint
inputs.label: Credentials for registries outside this organization/collection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Credentials to use for external registries located in the project's .npmrc. For registries in this organization/collection, leave this blank; the build’s credentials are used automatically.
